title: Practice case interviews with feedback
description: Work through consulting cases with structured frameworks, guidance, and intelligent feedback
prompt:
I'm practicing for consulting interviews. Set up this practice scenario for me—using case I've uploaded, extract the data into an spreadsheet model with formulas and frameworks. Then, tell me what questions I should focus on.

After I finish my analysis and write my recommendation, I'll share it for feedback. Review it like a senior partner would: check my numbers, evaluate my logic, and tell me specifically what needs improvement.
steps: Give Claude context (upload practice study files)
What Claude creates (financial analysis model and practice guide)
Follow up prompts (compare approaches, dive deeper into frameworks, request reviews)
prerequisites: Optional: Extended Thinking feature for detailed feedback
notes: Prompt contains apparent source typos ('using case I've uploaded', 'an spreadsheet'), reproduced as extracted.
